title: Build thin ridged weapon forms as one connected silhouette-and-ridge shell

exclusions: thick forged heads whose side views require multiple depth masses

preconditions: the silhouette and at least one internal ridge path are visible or strongly supported
the part is a continuous forged or machined blade rather than an assembly of plates
front and rear shell grids can use matching row correspondence
action_policy: Author outer silhouette paths and the internal ridge path before filling faces.
Bridge matching front and rear grids as one connected all-quad shell.
Use selective semantic creases on the physical outline and ridge with live unapplied SubD; do not smooth every edge indiscriminately.
At a pointed termination, keep a tiny valid terminal row or redirect topology; never collapse several distinct quad-row vertices to one coordinate.
recovery: retune silhouette stations before adding detail
obtain a secondary view when depth is critical
version_scope: Blender 5.2 LTS reproduction; tutorial demonstrates Blender 4.4.1
status_note: The topology rule transferred, but the tutorial reproduction did not reach the I0 visual-fidelity gate.
